name: @loom/experience-board-edit
description: loom-ui operations and planner accounting on a small greenhouse board: a user resizes a widget with setPlacement, the app titles the board with setTitle, a provider cannot be retired while a widget binds it (and never from a widget), the reference planner retires the provider its own removal orphaned, and the planner's token usage is served from the recorded decision on replay. Headless.
